title: Scout Troop 2
subtitle: Welcome to the Scout Troop 2 platform
select_scout: Select a scout to see their activity.
confirm_delete: Delete this scout and their whole history?
private_section: Private: only leaders can see the details below.
private_view_hint: Only signed-in accounts see this. To change anything, use the leader area.
photo_hidden_note: The picture is hidden on the dashboard. It still shows here.
activity_hint: This is the activity list of the troop you are working in. Leaders pick from it when awarding XP. Use a negative value (like -5) for activities that take XP away.
confirm_delete_activity: Delete this activity? Past awards keep their record.
confirm_delete_leader: Remove this leader? They will be logged out. Their scout profile stays in the list.
err_too_many: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err_unauthorized: Your session expired. Log in again.
err_weak_password: The password must be at least 8 characters.
err_cannot_delete_self: You can't remove your own account.
err_server: Something went wrong on the server.
err_too_large: That is too large to send.
labels_hint: These roles and tags belong to the troop you are working in. Create roles (like Patrol leader) and tags (like First aid), then assign them from a scout's page. Roles are shown on the public dashboard; tags are for leaders only.
confirm_delete_label: Delete this? It will be removed from all scouts.
display_name_hint: Optional. Leaders also appear in the scout list; this is the name shown there. Defaults to the username.
err_scout_is_leader: This scout is a leader's profile. Remove the leader first.
priority_hint: Roles only. A higher number is listed first in the scout list (0 = no priority). A scout with several roles uses the highest one; ties are ordered by XP.
err_super_not_in_council: The super admin can't be in this group.
account_patrol_hint: The account is added to the leaders' group automatically. You can pick its patrol later from the scout's page.
patrol_account_note: Leader accounts are in the leaders' group automatically, plus a patrol they are responsible for.
err_patrol_not_council: Pick a regular patrol; the account joins the leaders' group automatically.
pw_optional_hint: Leave empty to keep your password.
current_pw_hint: Enter your current password to confirm any change.
err_reason_required: Please give a reason for deactivating this scout.
deactivate_reason_hint: e.g. moved away, left the troop…
confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this scout? They leave the scout movement and disappear from the lists. Their history is kept and they can be reactivated later.
inactive_note: This scout is inactive (left the movement). They are hidden from the public list and can't be awarded XP until reactivated.
promote_hint: Move the scout up to a troop of a higher level. Their XP and history go with them; their patrol, roles and tags are removed because they belong to the old troop.
err_scout_inactive: This scout is inactive. Reactivate them first.
depot_hint: The depot inventory. Everyone can view and search it.
depot_empty: The depot has no items yet.
depot_res_confirm: Put back everything in this take?
depot_past_none: Nothing has been put back yet.
err_not_available: That quantity isn't available right now.
depot_confirm_delete: Remove this item from the depot?
depot_login_note: You need to be logged in as a leader or deputy leader to edit the inventory.
subtitle_named: Welcome {name} to the Scout Troop 2 platform
err_forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
err_no_patrol: You need to be in a patrol first. Ask an admin to put you in one.
mod_no_patrol: You aren't in charge of a patrol yet. Ask an admin to put you in one; you will then be able to change its scouts.
view_only_scout: View only: you can change only the scouts of your own {unit_l}.
view_banner: Viewing as {name} ({level}): view only, nothing can be changed
err_view_only: You're viewing as another account, so nothing can be changed. Exit the view first.
confirm_delete_admin: Remove this account? They will be logged out. Their scout profile stays in the list.
troops_hint: Each troop has its own scouts, leaders, activities and roles/tags. Switch troops from the bar above the tabs; the Activities and Roles & tags tabs always show the troop you are working in.
confirm_delete_troop: Delete this troop? It must have no scouts or leaders.
err_troop_not_empty: This troop still has scouts or leaders. Delete or move them first.
activity_hint_readonly: Leaders pick from this list when awarding XP. Only the super admin can change it.
troop_level_hint: Troops are levels: a higher number is a more senior troop. Scouts can only be promoted to a troop with a higher level. Leave empty to put a new troop above all the others.
troop_xp: This troop uses the XP system
troop_xp_hint: Off: the troop shows no XP, no XP can be awarded, there is no activities list, and attendance gives none. XP already given stays stored and returns if you switch it on again.
err_xp_disabled: This troop doesn't use the XP system.
err_not_higher: A scout can only be promoted to a troop with a higher level.
copy_from: Start with the activities and roles/tags of
copy_from_hint: Activities and roles/tags are separate for each troop. Copying only gives the new troop the same starting list; changes afterwards do not affect the other troop.
patrols_hint: {units} split a troop's scouts into groups. Put a scout in one from the scout's own page; the scout lists then show every group under its own heading.
confirm_delete_patrol: Delete this {unit_l}? No scouts are deleted; they just end up without a {unit_l}.
patrol_leaders_note: Leader accounts always stay in this group.
att_hint: Create a meeting or an event for each gathering and mark the scouts who were present. Only leaders see this register.
att_xp_hint: Each scout marked present gets {xp} XP automatically. Unmarking them, or deleting this meeting or event, takes it back.
att_xp_none: No XP is given for attending this one.
att_absent_xp: XP taken for absence without an excuse
att_xp_field_hint: XP for attending is given automatically to every scout marked present; XP taken for not attending is deducted from every scout marked absent. Use 0 for none.
audit_absence_excused: was marked absent with an excuse from
att_absent_hint: Each scout marked absent without an excuse loses {xp} XP; an excused absence takes nothing. Clearing the mark, or changing it, gives it back.
custom_xp_hint: A one-off award with its own title. A negative value (for example -5) deducts XP.
audit_absence: was marked absent without an excuse from
att_no_scouts: No active scouts in this troop yet.
att_summary_hint: Meetings and events attended out of those held since the scout joined.
confirm_delete_meeting: Delete this meeting or event, its attendance and the XP it gave?
home_scouts_hint: Browse the scouts and their XP
news_hint: Everyone sees the same home page. Tick every troop a post is about; an event can have several (an admin's own troop is always one of them). Tick "Show in the ticker" for the scrolling bar at the top. Give an activity or event a date and it is listed under "Coming up" until that day.
confirm_delete_post: Delete this post from the home page?
reports_hint: Every Saturday each troop writes what it did at its weekly meeting. Everyone can read them; once signed in, a troop's leaders, deputy leaders, assistant leaders and helpers write and edit only their own troop's report (the general leader writes for any troop).
home_reports_hint: What each troop did this week
home_ticker_empty: No news for the time being
post_troops_hint: Tick every troop that takes part: an event can have several.
post_pick_troop: Pick at least one troop, or All troops.
admin_signin: Sign in as the super admin to open Administration.
slogan_hint: Shown next to the troop's name at the top of the leader area, for example "Always Prepared".
music_add_title: Add a scout to the team
music_add_hint: Pick a scout who already has a profile in a troop; new scouts can't be created here. The scout stays in the troop and keeps the troop's XP separate from the team's XP.
music_no_candidates: Every scout is already in the team.
music_empty: No one is in the musical team yet.
music_select: Pick a member to see their XP.
music_confirm_remove: Remove this scout from the musical team? They stay in their troop, and their team XP is kept in case they are added again.
music_meeting_hint: The musical team has its own weekly practices and its own XP, separate from the troops. Each member marked present gets the attending XP automatically.
music_summary_hint: Practices attended out of those held since the member joined the team.
music_confirm_delete_meeting: Delete this practice, its attendance and the XP it gave?
err_music_already: This scout is already in the musical team.
acct_helper_opt: Helper (called Rover in a Rovers troop)
music_xp_hint: Each member marked present gets {xp} XP automatically. Unmarking them, or deleting this practice, takes it back.
music_xp_none: No XP is given for attending this practice.
music_xp_field_hint: XP for attending is given automatically to every member marked present, and XP for absence is deducted from every member marked absent. Use 0 for none.
music_depot_hint: The instruments the team owns. This is the team's own depot, separate from the troops' depot.
music_depot_confirm_delete: Remove this instrument from the depot?
confirm_delete_week: Delete the week of {date} from the reports, with every troop's report in it? This can't be undone.
audit_report_week_delete: deleted a week from the weekly reports:
import_hint: Choose a file or paste text: either a table with one scout per row (a spreadsheet saved as CSV, or copied from Excel; the first row holds the column names) or one filled-in form per scout (lines like "Name: …", forms separated by a blank line or a line of dashes). Column names and labels in Arabic or English are recognised. You check a preview before anything is added; scouts join the troop you are working in.
import_found: {n} found: {ok} ready to add, {skip} to skip (untick or tick any row below).
import_none: No scouts were found. The first row should hold column names (like Name, Phone), or each form should have lines like "Name: …".
import_too_many: Up to {n} scouts at a time: split the file.
import_file_error: The file could not be read.
